subject: Caravel / Redwood SI Enablement Kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Avery Brooks <avery.brooks@caravel.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Caravel / Redwood SI Enablement Kickoff

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for partnering with Redwood on the Caravel integration. We want to get your SI team productive quickly and reduce friction for the first customer engagements. Proposed kickoff agenda below (60–75 minutes):

- Introductions & objectives (10 min)
- Technical integration overview (20 min)
- Common deployment patterns & caveats (15 min)
- Enablement plan and hands-on labs (15–30 min)

Action items for this thread: please confirm the two technical leads who will attend, and whether Oct 6 or Oct 8 works for a kickoff session (we'll schedule a calendar invite once we confirm). I attached a short onboarding checklist and a high-level integration matrix to help frame the discussion.

Attachments: Caravel_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (2 pages), Redwood_Integration_Matrix.xlsx (workbook)

We expect to cover: model variants we recommend for production, auth and key management, recommended KV/cache patterns, and a short lab for request/response telco tests. If there's any regulatory or data locality constraints on your side, flag them here so we can route the right people.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber | Senior Partner Solutions Manager

From: Avery Brooks <avery.brooks@caravel.com>

Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Caravel / Redwood SI Enablement Kickoff

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Oct 6 (Wednesday) at 10am PT works for us. I've looped in Diego Alvarez (Solutions Architect) who will co-lead the technical portion. Diego and I will also bring an SRE who owns our deployment automation.

Quick notes from our side:
- Primary use cases we want to enable first are customer-facing chat assistants and a batch-embedding pipeline for search ranking.
- We have a requirement to keep embeddings in-region (US-West); please document any storage/caching recommendations for that.
- We will need a short list of sample prompts and a small dataset for the lab — can Redwood provide that or should Caravel supply realistic examples?

If possible, could you share the meeting invite and any pre-reads? We'll review the onboarding checklist and matrix ahead of time.

Best,
Avery Brooks
Partnerships Lead | Caravel Solutions
avery.brooks@caravel.com | +1 206 555 0202

Avery / Diego —

Great — thanks for confirming. A couple of prep notes and owners so the session is productive:

Pre-reads (please review before Oct 6):
- Redwood_Integration_Matrix.xlsx (contains recommended runtime profiles, batching guidance, and KV/cache notes) — I've added comments to the Embeddings sheet about in-region storage options.
- Caravel_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf — check the sections marked "data locality" and "auth & keys."

Proposed owners / tasks prior to kickoff:
- Redwood: Marissa Cole to prepare a 10–15 min hands-on lab using a small search dataset (Marissa will put sample prompts and a test CSV in the shared drive).
- Caravel: Diego to confirm the SRE attendee and share sample deployment manifests (k8s/tf) for the embedding pipeline.
- Redwood: Laura to add a short runbook snippet for rolling back model version changes in Dedicated environments.

Deadlines: please upload manifests and any sample customer prompts to the shared drive by EOD Oct 2 so Marissa can finalize the lab.

Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD_ExampleSharedDrive

Attachments (for reference): Redwood_Integration_Matrix.xlsx

If any constraints around audit logs, encryption keys, or approval processes exist on Caravel's side, flag them now so we can invite the right compliance folks to the kickoff.

Thanks — Laura
